subject: PO requirements, milestone invoicing & net terms for pilot engagement
messages:
From: Samantha Price <samantha.price@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Analytics Procurement <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Apr 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO requirements and invoice cadence for Redwood pilot

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Acme is excited to pilot Redwood for our analytics assistant. Procurement has a couple of non-standard asks before we can issue a PO and get legal moving:

- PO must reference our internal contract number and include a purchase-order PDF (we can attach once final).
- Net 45 terms preferred (our standard is net45 for vendors > $50k).
- We would like the option for milestone invoices (50% on signature, 25% on pilot completion, 25% on production rollout). If milestone billing is not possible, we need monthly invoices.
- All invoices should include a line for "Data processing fees" separate from usage if applicable.

Can you confirm Redwood can accommodate the milestone cadence and net45? Also please send an updated SOW/PO template we can attach to our system. If these terms affect pricing/discounting, please flag that so I can take to my finance lead.

Appreciate a quick reply — procurement is trying to lock down vendors this week.

Best,
Samantha Price
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Analytics

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Price <samantha.price@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Apr 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements and invoice cadence for Redwood pilot

Samantha — thanks for the clear summary. We can support the PO + PO PDF requirement and include your contract reference on the invoice. Quick answers up front:

- Net 45: we can accept net45 for this engagement, provided we have a signed SOW and a PO for the committed pilot spend.
- Milestone invoicing: yes, we can invoice on the milestone cadence you suggested (50/25/25). Our billing system supports milestone invoices tied to the SOW.
- Monthly invoices alternative: we can do monthly invoices if you prefer, but note our standard discount tiers assume either monthly or upfront billing cadence — milestone billing will affect the effective cash timing.
- Data processing line: we will include a separate line item for processing/hosting where applicable.

Regarding pricing: to accommodate net45 + milestone invoicing we will need to limit the promotional discount we offered in the initial proposal. We can do a 12% pilot discount (instead of the 18% promo) if Acme signs a 12-month committed consumption addendum. If Acme prefers no longer-term commitment, the discount would be 8%. I'm happy to run the numbers with Marissa/Ben below.

I'm attaching: PO_template_v3.pdf (fillable) and Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf (pilot SOW with milestone table). If these look OK I can send a DocuSign packet that populates the PO reference field for your procurement system.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm milestone vs monthly cadence.
2) If milestone, Acme confirms desired discount tier (12% for 12-month commitment or 8% for no-commit).
3) I send DocuSign + final SOW/PO fields for signature and PO issuance.

Looping in Marissa and Ben for finance/billing sign-off.

Thanks — Connor
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: PO_template_v3.pdf (fillable), Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Acme procurement asks (net45 + milestone) — quick finance check

Marissa / Ben,

Acme procurement wants net45 + milestone invoices for the pilot (50/25/25). They also require the PO PDF and contract reference on invoices. Pricing impact: I'm proposing 12% pilot discount if they sign a 12-month commit; otherwise 8% for no-commit pilot.

Can we accept net45? From a cash perspective, net45 with milestone invoicing is workable if we:
- Require PO up front that covers the pilot committed spend OR
- For pilot-only engagements < $75k, we can accept PO + net45 without additional credit checks.

Anything else I should bake into the SOW to make the billing flow smooth (billing contact, invoice remittance address, PO number field)? I'd rather not push for shorter terms in this account since they are strategic for Q3.

Quick replies welcome — procurement is pushing to close this week.

—Connor

From: Samantha Price <samantha.price@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Analytics Procurement <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 09:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements and invoice cadence for Redwood pilot

Connor — apologies for the short delay, we had to run the options through finance. Good news: procurement can accept milestone invoicing with net45 and will issue a PO that covers the pilot committed spend. A few confirmations from our side: 

- PO will reference our internal contract number CN-ACME-2026-41 and we'll upload the PO PDF once DocuSign is complete.
- We accept the 12% pilot discount on the condition of a 12-month committed consumption addendum (fine to include usage caps).
- Please include a separate invoice line for "Data processing fees" and ensure the invoice includes a field for our PO number.
- Final ask: can Redwood send the first invoice (50%) within 5 business days of SOW signature, with subsequent milestone invoices tied to the pilot completion date and production go-live? Our AP team will process invoices on a net45 basis upon receipt.

If those terms match your SOW, please send the DocuSign packet and we'll generate the PO number. Also include the remit-to address that should appear on the invoices.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Samantha Price
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Analytics
procurement@acmeanalytics.com
